description: I am Nathari Liyanarachchi and I'm astro lover. I have been learning astronomy science my childhood. Currently I have completed my Advanced Level Examination in Physical science stream. I'm so glad to work with other people as a team. Since this is a great oppotunity for students who are enthusiastic in science, maths and astronomy I think we can collaborately work for the success of this project.
summary: This is the project I did for NASA's Space Apps Challenge 2026.  I chose the ' Abandoned but not forgotten: Storytelling about NASA's discarded equipment on Mars and the Moon. I wrote a short story related to the Phoenix Mars mission based on the real scientific data gathered from NASA's official websites. I have included all the science behind the mission in an interesting way, and I hope readers will enjoy the book. This story will address readers who are enthusiastic about space exploration and willing to learn about past space missions. My project will help the readers to get a clear and easy understanding about the Phoenix mission.
details: My project is about a short story related to the Phoenix Mars mission. Since this is written in a modern, classical style, readers will be able to get a clear understanding of the science behind the story. By reading the story about the past space mission, readers will get interested in learning more about the mission and will search for past missions. By this, the missions that led to the discovery of important facts about the solar system and the universe will never be forgotten. We used Microsoft software for writing purposes. Since this is a short story, our team mainly considered about the shortness of the story by only including a limited cast and we tried to draw the focus only on the space mission.
dataRefs: NASA's phoenix mission faces survival challenges
